notes: A better level test when you start: after the character check come 4 word cards with 4 meanings each (a right answer asks a harder level, a wrong one an easier one) and a short story with one question. Your starting level comes from all of it, plus the level you said. Starting above HSK 1 puts every word of the levels below into your word bank as known, and those levels sit folded in one row on Learn. Every onboarding page has a back button
